prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was thinking about that stretch in 2025 when I bounced between Wuhan, Chongqing, and Chengdu—felt like I lived out of a suitcase.
In Wuhan, I remember the home service visit was on 2025-05-09, and we specifically picked the morning slot back then.
The address they went to was Room 209, Tower 3, Pearl Gardens—my phone on the form was 13864788741, which I still have saved in my notes.
Then in Chongqing, our group dinner in 2025 was at Xiao Tian E Hotpot—pretty sure that was the exact restaurant name on the booking.
That meal was on 2025-05-21 at 20:00, and there were 4 of us squeezing around the table.
It was booked under Lin Bo, and the contact number they used was 13813897597—he joked he’d never forget it after all the confirmation texts.
And in Chengdu, I’d already reserved a spot at Chunxi Road IFS Parking starting 2025-03-12 19:00 for 4 hours—plate was 苏F89012, and the driver phone on it was 13830018365.
